question: Patient comprehension of emergency department care and instructions: are patients aware of when they do not understand?
reference_answer: No. Many patients do not understand their ED care or their discharge instructions. Moreover, most patients appear to be unaware of their lack of understanding and report inappropriate confidence in their comprehension and recall.
